key_findings: WMI pathToSignedProductExe can be a stale uninstall registration: QQPCMgr 18.2.30648.204 directory does not exist
Defender MpCmdRun.exe -? works (rc=0) but real -Scan fails with hr=0x800106ba because WinDefend is STOPPED (Start=3)
Kaspersky KES avp.com SCAN defaults to /i2 which deletes files; /i0 is required for report-only
Defender -DisableRemediation is only valid for -ScanType 3; full and quick scans are not exposed
Huorong hrconsole scan is Linux-server-only; QQPCMgr and 360 have no official Windows CLI
Unverified web claims about hrun.exe /scan and TencentPCMgr.exe /scan were rejected as unfounded
safety: engine availability derives from real path, service state and signature, never from product name alone
engines not locally verified refuse real execution without explicit --allow-unverified
guide-only engines never fabricate scan jobs or results
custom scope without --path is rejected before any real execution
no system service state changes, no scheduled tasks, no writes outside version directory
multi_engine.prototype: ENGINE_MATRIX and PROBE_FACTS are read-only real snapshots; settings dropdown disables unavailable engines

startup_bootstrap.model: At startup the application checks its own component list (Kaspersky, Node, etc.). Missing items are listed first; only after explicit user consent does the application itself download, verify and place them inside its own directory. The product provides an install capability, it does not bundle third-party binaries or rely on an external agent to install them.
hard_boundaries: startup_check is read-only: no download, no install, no writes at all
install refuses any request without the exact consent token
download_to_app writes only into versions/v0.10/engines; guided items only expose an official URL
unverified downloads are renamed and archived, never enabled
no third-party binary is bundled or committed
missing optional capabilities never block startup

kaspersky_distinction.kvrt: portable free tool, downloaded into app directory, default path
kaspersky_distinction.kaspersky_free: full antivirus writing system drivers and services; official URL only, never installed silently

startup_bootstrap.node_note: Node.js is a dev/build tool here, not a client runtime dependency, because the frontend is a dependency-free single HTML file
